reasoning: The icon shows an outlined circle crossed by a diagonal slash, universally read as 'cancel', 'prohibited/blocked', 'disabled', or the empty set (∅). While a concrete noun icon (like a flight, phone, or card) beats it when a specific object is named, it serves well when the action of cancelling subscriptions, blocking access, or opting out is the core point of the task. It is easily confused with standard ban/no icons and generic 'off' state toggles.

pass1.ambiguity: At small sizes it looks identical to a standard prohibition/no sign, the mathematical empty-set symbol (∅), or a generic 'disabled' UI toggle.
